description: This file defines the MainActivity class and the main composable function SmartHomeApp for an Android TV application built with Jetpack Compose. It sets up the activity lifecycle, themes, and navigation routes for the app screens, including home, device details, and CCTV screens, with route parameters.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class serving as the entry point of the SmartHome TV app, responsible for initializing the app and setting the Compose content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the activity, enables edge-to-edge display, and sets the Compose UI content.

methods.name: SmartHomeApp
methods.description: Composable function that manages app navigation with NavController and defines the routes for home, device details, and CCTV screens.
